_doc: Authored enrichment layer — edges a human asserts that the graph cannot derive. Schema: docs/authored-edges.md. Joined by build-graph.py; additive to edges.json (no card projects these, so the round-trip is untouched).
_refs: between/for take a bare glyph (人 → g:人), a word surface + the entry's `audience` (可不 + cn → w:可不@cn), or an explicit node id (g:入, w:不可@cn). Every ref must resolve to a real node or the build errors.

edges.note: The same two characters reversed. 不可 = 'cannot / must not'. 可不 is NOT its negation: it is either the 可不可… A-not-A frame ('can or can't…?') or, colloquially, 可不(是) = emphatic agreement ('isn't it just').

examples.gloss: Isn't it just! / That's so true! — 可不(是) = emphatic agreement
(I) simply must go. — 非…不可 = 'cannot not' = must
